title: Automated flows
subtitle: See each flow's entry message in English and Arabic, and the approval status of every version.
info.title: How Arabic versions work in flows
info.sending: Arabic versions are prepared and tracked here; automatic sending of Arabic versions by flows is switched on separately. Until then, customers receive the English message.
info.approval: Each Arabic version must be approved by WhatsApp and reviewed by a native Arabic speaker before it can be used.
empty: You don't have any automated flows yet.
trigger.label: Trigger
sameButtons: Button labels in every language must keep the same number and order as the English message. The editor locks this for you.
noArabicYet: No Arabic version yet. Customers who speak Arabic will receive the English message.
